messages:
alex: Heads-up: PR #4321 updates the dashboard cost breakdown example but the cost annotation line is confusing — it shows "per-request" but our runtime reports per-token. Can we decide wording?

marta: Agree. Saw it in preview. We should either say "per-token" or show both with a formula. @sam do you have numbers?

sam: I can add a small note with the formula: cost_per_request = tokens_generated * cost_per_token. Quick snippet:

```text
# example
tokens_generated = 120
cost_per_token = 0.00003
cost_per_request = tokens_generated * cost_per_token  # = 0.0036
```

marta: Nice. Also need latency breakdown: model-inference vs network vs batching overhead. The dashboard widget currently shows a single 'latency' metric.

ria: I can update the dashboard YAML snippet to include submetrics. Should this go into PR #4321 or a follow-up?

alex: Add to the same PR if it's a small tweak. Split if it grows. @docbot please run linkcheck on the updated doc.

docbot: linkcheck: queued for PR 4321. ETA ~10m.

sam: I'll push the snippet change + a short note that costs exclude infra overhead. Pushing in ~20m.

marta: Also add a line about routing fallbacks (cheaper model variants) since that impacts cost calc.

alex: SGTM. Who will merge after CI?

ria: If tests + linkcheck pass, I'll merge.

sam: :thumbsup: pushing now. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

docbot: linkcheck: passed. 5 broken links fixed automatically.

alex: Thanks all — I'll add a blurb in the release notes about the docs tweak.
